Pasadena Uber and Lyft Accident Lawyer

Hurt in an Uber or Lyft in Pasadena, Old Town, or after a Rose Bowl event? Learn how 2026 coverage changes affect your claim. Free consultation: 323-452-5222.

Rideshare Crashes in Pasadena

Old Pasadena's nightlife, Caltech, the Convention Center, and Rose Bowl events bring heavy Uber and Lyft traffic. Drivers stopping suddenly on Colorado Boulevard, making U-turns for pickups, and watching their phones cause frequent accidents.

Know the 2026 Coverage Change

Since January 1, 2026, SB 371 has cut the uninsured and underinsured motorist coverage Uber and Lyft must carry during rides from $1 million to $60,000 per person and $300,000 per accident. If an uninsured or underinsured driver hits you while you are in a rideshare, the coverage may be much smaller than you expect.

How We Help

  • Secure app data showing the driver's status at the time of the crash
  • Identify every policy that may apply, including your own
  • Handle all communication with Uber, Lyft, and their insurers
  • Document your injuries and losses

Attorney Vardan Daldumyan is a former in-house trial attorney for an insurance company. Our Glendale office is minutes from Pasadena. We speak Armenian.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use my own insurance after a rideshare crash?

Possibly. Your own uninsured or underinsured motorist coverage and medical payments coverage may apply, even when you were a passenger. We review your policy as part of your case.

How quickly should I contact a lawyer?

As soon as you can. App data, video, and witness information are easiest to secure in the first days after a crash.
